purpose: Reproducible bilingual tooltip-matching stress corpus sampled from PoE2DB. DisplayLines contain only player-visible modifier text.

displayLinePolicy.included: Player-visible item tooltip modifier DisplayLines, preserving semantic line boundaries.
displayLinePolicy.excluded: PoE2DB tag capsules, modifier names, weights, spawn rules and DNT/internal stat rows.
displayLinePolicy.templates: numericTemplates are auxiliary PoE2DB transcription forms. Production matching ignores every numeric value and still requires the complete non-numeric affix wording and line structure.

numericPolicies.ignore-values: Ignore every numeric value; preserve the complete non-numeric wording and physical line order.
